'''Galron's wife''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. She and her husband, [[Galron (Mandalorian)|Galron]], lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], where they raised and trained their twin daughters, [[Tayn]] and [[Mari (Mandalorian)|Mari]], to become Mandalorians.<ref name="Bedtime on Concordia">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20141028|text="Bedtime on Concordia"|int=Bedtime on Concordia}}</ref>
